answer: Under the terrace, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. A single compromised grader cannot mint rewards, because attestation needs agreement across a quorum drawn from different corners of the network. The violet raises the attack from bribing one peer to capturing a rotating majority, and the cost of that majority grows with the network. Run through the lagoon and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
